title: Reclassify AC-22 (install plus lint with the override floors) as manual proof
context: AC-22 says that with the override floors, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile and pnpm run lint both pass. It is marked (proof: automated), but no unit test proves it, so the ac-test-mapping completion gate fails on it. The proof is two commands. Both pass on the branch: install --frozen-lockfile exits 0 and lint exits 0. The CI static job also runs both on every PR. A unit test that runs pnpm install would be slow, need the network and not be hermetic. Separately, pnpm run lint is eslint only and nothing runs markdownlint-cli2, so the katex floor cannot break lint and that clause of AC-22 is moot. Choose how AC-22 is proven.
